phase: Phase 31: High-Definition Offline Vector Topographic & Trail Elevation Profile HUD

stories.title: Pure KMP Offline Vector Map Tile Parser & Spatial Bounding Box Cacher
stories.description: Implement OfflineVectorTileEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/geo/ providing pure Kotlin protobuf/MVT tile decompression, local SQLite/spatial index caching, and zero Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Parses MVT vector map tiles from local storage with zero network access
Spatial bounding-box queries return road vectors and topographic contours in < 15ms

stories.title: Real-Time Convoy Elevation Profile & Altitude Incline Math Engine
stories.description: Implement ConvoyElevationEngine.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/geo/ computing route grade percentage, upcoming elevation summits, and relative altitude deltas between convoy lead and tail riders.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates moving elevation profile and slope grade percentage from GPS telemetry
Detects steep alpine descent/climb warnings (> 12% grade)
Computes relative vertical altitude separation between convoy members

stories.title: Tactile Trail Elevation HUD Overlay & Cockpit Sheet Presentation
stories.description: Create TrailElevationHudOverlay.kt in app/sharedUI and integrate into MainCockpitScreen.kt and iOS SwiftUI ContentView.swift. Renders dynamic elevation profile line chart with color-coded convoy rider altitude pins and glove-friendly scale toggles.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders high-contrast OLED altitude profile chart with 64dp glove-friendly zoom buttons
Displays real-time rider pins along elevation curve with distance markers
Wired reactively via IntercomBridge to iOS Native SwiftUI with CancellationHandle
Compiles cleanly across Android and iOS targets

stories.title: Alpine Mountain Pass Multi-Node Elevation & Trail Sync Simulation Test
stories.description: Implement AlpineElevationSimulationTest.kt validating a 12-node convoy climbing a 2,500m mountain pass. Simulates altitude delta tracking, automatic grade warnings, and vector route synchronization under intermittent BLE mesh connectivity.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 12 nodes ascending alpine pass with 1,200m elevation gain
Verifies elevation profile calculation and straggler vertical distance warnings
